title: Design System: Jonatan Marín — Data & AI Engineering

display.purpose: Hero headline only — the loudest, rarest treatment on the site.

headline.purpose: Every section title, same font stack as Display at lower weight/size.

body.purpose: Sitewide default reading font (set on <body>); Hero subheadline is the one Rajdhani exception.

tag.purpose: Sentence-case capability chips (technology names) — distinct from the uppercase mono Label voice.

label.purpose: Nav links, eyebrows, buttons, pills, badges, HUD text — the single most-used treatment on the site.

shadows.name: glow-primary-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover glow for the primary filled button.

shadows.name: glow-outline-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover glow for outline buttons and cyan-bordered accents.

shadows.name: glow-card-service-hover
shadows.purpose: Subtle hover glow on service cards.

shadows.name: shadow-card-project-hover
shadows.purpose: The one true drop-shadow exception, always paired with the cyan glow, on Work project-card hover.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition easing across buttons, cards, and toggles.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal fade/translate-in duration for sections and cards.

motion.name: duration-micro
motion.purpose: Micro-interaction duration for color/border hover shifts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid cyan CTA button — the site's single primary action treatment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; background: var(--cyan); color: #000; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(var(--cyan-rgb), 0.35); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent cyan-bordered CTA button — the site's single secondary action treatment.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; color: var(--cyan); border: 1px solid var(--cyan); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { background: rgba(var(--cyan-rgb), 0.1); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(var(--cyan-rgb), 0.35); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Mono uppercase status/metadata pill, colored per its own accent (layer color, vendor color, etc).
components.css: .ds-tag-pill { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); border: 1px solid var(--gold); background: transparent; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 20px; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-tag-pill:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Capability Chip
components.description: Sentence-case technology-name chip used in the TechStack section.
components.css: .ds-capability-chip { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: rgba(var(--panel-rgb), 0.7); padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 6px; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-capability-chip:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); color: var(--cyan); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Glass-panel card used for the three Services entries.
components.html:
Data Engineering & Architecture

Enterprise-scale pipelines built on Medallion Architecture.
components.css: .ds-card-service { background: rgba(var(--panel-rgb), 0.7); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 32px 28px; transition: border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-card-service:hover { border-color: rgba(var(--cyan-rgb), 0.3); box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(var(--cyan-rgb), 0.08); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-service-title { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--heading); margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-service-desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.8; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Case-study card used in the Work grid — the one component with a true drop-shadow on hover.
components.html:
Case Study 01
Medallion Architecture · Microsoft Fabric
components.css: .ds-card-project { background: rgba(var(--panel-rgb), 0.9); border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border); transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-card-project:hover { background: rgba(var(--panel-rgb), 0.97); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 0 40px rgba(var(--cyan-rgb), 0.35); } .ds-card-project-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-card-project-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); } .ds-card-project-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan); } .ds-card-project-title { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--heading); line-height: 1.3; }

components.css: .ds-hud-panel { background: rgba(var(--panel-rgb), 0.8); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; font-family: var(--font-mono); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-hud-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-hud-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--cyan); } .ds-hud-date { font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-hud-status-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-hud-status-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text); } .ds-hud-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-hud-dot-syncing { background: var(--cyan); animation: ds-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-hud-value { margin-left: auto; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(var(--cyan-rgb), 0.35); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(var(--cyan-rgb), 0.35), 0 0 48px rgba(var(--cyan-rgb), 0.2); } }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a single, precise instrument panel rather than a marketing page: an almost-black canvas, one electric-cyan signal color, and UI chrome — status dots, uppercase mono labels, letter-spaced eyebrows — that behaves like telemetry rather than decoration. The clearest expression of the North Star is the HUD sidebar next to the Medallion architecture diagram: a title-plus-timestamp header, a service-status list with pulsing dots, colored metadata pills, and rectangular mono control buttons — every other surface on the site borrows that same instrumented vocabulary at a lower intensity.

The voice is restrained technical precision, not cinematic spectacle. Earlier iterations of this system leaned further into a dark neon/gaming aesthetic (glitch text on the name, a custom cursor with a particle halo, a terminal easter egg); all of it was deliberately removed to read as a senior consultant's services page rather than a portfolio chasing attention. What survived — the dark canvas, the single accent, the sci-fi-adjacent HUD panels — stayed because it doubles as genuine product evidence (it looks like the kind of data-operations tooling the underlying services actually build), not because it looks impressive on its own.
keyCharacteristics: One interactive accent color (electric cyan) carries every call-to-action, active state, and glow — never diluted with a second general-UI accent.
Reading and chrome text defaults to a monospace voice; a second, more humanist face (Rajdhani) appears only for the hero's subheadline and component/card titles.
Flat, glass-panel surfaces at rest; elevation is communicated by a cyan glow plus a small upward shift on hover/selection, not by drop shadows.
Bronze/Silver/Gold and the Azure/Fabric/Power BI vendor hues are semantic and quarantined — they exist only inside the Medallion diagram and its vendor badges, never as general UI color.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the entire accent vocabulary; a second general-purpose accent is never introduced.

rules.name: The Diagram-Only Rule
rules.body: Bronze/silver/gold appear exclusively inside the Medallion architecture visualization and its own legend — never as a button, link, badge, or any other general UI color.

rules.name: The Vendor Badge Rule
rules.body: Each vendor color is scoped to that specific provider's own icon, badge, or labeled node — never applied to unrelated UI, and never used interchangeably with cyan.

rules.name: The Mono Voice Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the default for both body copy and UI chrome; Rajdhani is the exception, reserved for the Hero subheadline and component/card titles only — it never becomes the base body font.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Depth is communicated by a cyan glow plus a small position shift, not by dark drop-shadows — the one exception (Work cards) adds shadow only on top of, never instead of, the glow.

rules.name: The Rectangular-Core, Round-Chrome Rule
rules.body: If it holds content, keep it near-square (≤10px radius). If it describes something — a tag, a status, a toggle — make it a stadium or a circle.

rules.name: The Two-Variant Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a third button treatment (e.g., a filled neutral or a ghost/ghost-outline button) — every CTA is either filled-cyan or outline-cyan.

dos: Do keep Electric Signal Cyan as the only general-UI interactive accent — buttons, links, focus states, glows, and progress indicators all route through it.
Do default reading and chrome text to JetBrains Mono; reserve Rajdhani for the Hero subheadline and component/card titles only.
Do keep every new surface flat-at-rest and communicate elevation with a cyan glow + small lift on hover/selection, matching the Glow-Is-Elevation Rule.

Do theme any new hardcoded color through the existing RGB-triplet CSS-variable pattern (rgba(var(--x-rgb), alpha)) so the light/dark theme toggle keeps working — never hardcode rgba(13,19,33,*), rgba(5,8,16,*), #080c18, #fff as a heading color, or a literal rgba(0,245,255,*).
Do keep Bronze/Silver/Gold inside the Medallion diagram and Azure/Fabric/Power BI inside their own vendor badges, per the Diagram-Only and Vendor Badge Rules.
donts: Don't add a second general-purpose accent color, or a third button variant beyond filled-cyan/outline-cyan.
Don't use violet/gold/bronze/silver anywhere outside the Medallion diagram, its legend, or (violet specifically) a background radial gradient under 0.05 opacity.
Don't reach for a drop-shadow as a default elevation cue — glow is the system's depth language; the Work-card drop-shadow is a named exception, not a precedent.

Don't round a structural container (card, panel, button) past ~10px, and don't leave a metadata/status element (tag, pill, toggle) with a small squared-off radius — corner shape signals content vs. chrome.
